hero.subheadline: Most people don't. Ryujin gives you total clarity over your finances — so you can move forward with intention, not just survive the month.
hero.trustLine: No cost. No card. No catch.

why.label: Why Ryujin exists
why.title: Because checking your bank balance isn't enough
why.description: Your account balance tells you where you are today. Ryujin tells you if you're actually moving forward, why, and what to do to get where you want faster.
why.card1Title: You don't know if you're doing well or not
why.card1Desc: You have money in the bank but don't know if it's enough. Ryujin shows your real state: income, expenses, debts and savings in a single view.
why.card2Title: Your goals stay in your head
why.card2Desc: "I want to save for X" exists only as an intention. Ryujin turns your goals into plans with real numbers and shows your progress week by week.
why.card3Title: You don't know what to do with your investments
why.card3Desc: Are you winning or losing? Is it worth it? Ryujin consolidates your portfolio and gives you the full picture to make informed decisions.

features.label: Everything in one place
features.title: What you need for total clarity
features.description: This isn't just another budget app. It's the place where you understand your real financial situation and know exactly what to do.
features.totalControlDesc: Log your income sources, categorize your spending, and understand where every dollar goes. No guessing.
features.smartInvestmentsDesc: Stocks, ETFs, fixed income — all in one portfolio with real returns and live market data.
features.clearGoalsDesc: Set what you want to achieve, when, and how much to save monthly to get there. Ryujin does the math.
features.advancedAnalyticsDesc: No boring spreadsheets. Visualizations that let you understand patterns and trends at a glance.
features.debtControlDesc: See all your debts, due dates, and installments. Nothing slips through, nothing surprises you.
features.decisionsDesc: Projection calculator, savings and investment simulations. Before you act, you know what to expect.

howItWorks.label: How it works
howItWorks.title: Three steps to understand your finances
howItWorks.step1Desc: Income, fixed expenses, debts, accounts. Once, and Ryujin builds the complete picture.
howItWorks.step2Title: Define where you want to go
howItWorks.step2Desc: A trip? Pay off debt? Invest more? You set the goal, Ryujin tells you what you need to do each month.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Update your data, see how you're advancing, and make informed decisions. That simple.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: If you have doubts, someone else probably did too.
faq.a1: Yes, completely free. No paid plan, no credit card required, no features hidden behind a paywall. Ryujin exists because the creator needed it — and wants you to be able to use it too.
faq.q2: Why should I trust it with my financial data?
faq.a2: Your data is stored with AES-256 encryption. We never share information with third parties. You own your data and can delete it anytime. Ryujin has no incentive to monetize your information — that's not the model.
faq.q3: Do I need to know about finance to use Ryujin?
faq.a3: Not at all. Ryujin is designed for people who want to get organized, not for experts. If you can write down how much you earn and spend, Ryujin does the rest.
faq.q4: Can I track investments in different currencies?
faq.a4: Yes. Each account, income source and investment can have its own currency. Ryujin converts everything to your base currency for a consolidated view.
faq.a5: Right now it's a responsive web app that works great on mobile. A native app is on the roadmap.
faq.q6: What if I stop using it for a while?
faq.a6: Nothing. Your data is still there when you come back. No subscription that expires, no account deactivated for inactivity.
